label: Teaching overlay only. Vehicle motion prefers RouterDecision.dispatches (resource_id) when set. Rows that disagree with the gateway are marked. Not repo policy.

rules.action: Needs a hospital and the street is flooded: send a boat to the clinic.
P1 medical dependent (oxygen, dialysis): boat and a medical team from the jetty, then to the clinic.
P1 trapped or rising water: rescue boat from the jetty, then on to the shelter.
P2 evacuate: evacuation boat from the shelter to the house, then back to the shelter. A flooded segment of that drawn path stays on the same boat.
Aid eligibility or denial: no vehicle. A human caseworker reviews. This is the check Sapling's scope names.
P3 shelter question: evacuation boat from the shelter to the house, then back. No separate supply boat.
P3 food or water: supply boat from Sun Chuai Lue Nam Thuam to the house.
P4 information: SMS broadcast pulse at the house. No vehicle leaves a depot.
